---
title: "gg_Marker_Scatter()"
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = F, warning = F)
```

```{r}
library(gwaspr)
```

The function `gg_Marker_Scatter()` creates marker plots with your `myY` and `myG` GWAS input files.

# Load data

> Note: `header = T`

```{r eval = F}
# Load genotype file (note: header = T)
myG <- read.csv("gwaspr_myG_hmp.csv", header = T)
```

```{r eval = F}
# Load phenotype file
myY <- read.csv("gwaspr_myY.csv")
```

---

# Single marker, two traits

Specifying a `trait.x`, `trait.y`, and `markers` along with your genotype and phenotype data as `xG` and `xY` is needed to create marker plots.

```{r eval = F}
# Plot
mp <- gg_Marker_Scatter(
  # Genotype data
  xG = myG, 
  # Phenotype data
  xY = myY,
  # Select traits to plot
  trait.x = "DTF_Sask_2017",
  trait.y = "DTF_Nepal_2017",
  # Select markers to plot
  markers = "Lcu.1GRN.Chr6p3269280" )
# Save
ggsave("figures/gg_Marker_Scatter_01.png", 
       mp, width = 6, height = 4 )
```

![](figures/gg_Marker_Box_01.png)

---

# All options

`gg_Marker_Bar()` contains a number of different options for customizing the marker plots.

```{r eval = F}
# Prep data
markers <- c("Lcu.1GRN.Chr6p3269280")
# Plot
mp <- gg_Marker_Scatter(
  xG = myG, 
  xY = myY,
  trait.x = "DTF_Sask_2017",
  trait.y = "DTF_Nepal_2017",
  markers = markers,
  marker.colors = gwaspr_Colors,
  remove.hets = F,
  point.size = 1,
  title = NULL,
  legend.rows = 1,
  subtitle = paste(markers, collapse = "\n") )
# Save
ggsave("figures/gg_Marker_Scatter_02.png", 
       mp, width = 6, height = 4 )
```

![](figures/gg_Marker_Box_02.png)

---

# Multiple markers

```{r eval = F}
# Plot
mp <- gg_Marker_Scatter(
  # Genotype data
  xG = myG, 
  # Phenotype data
  xY = myY,
  # Select traits to plot
  trait.x = "DTF_Sask_2017",
  trait.y = "DTF_Nepal_2017",
  # Select markers to plot
  markers = c("Lcu.1GRN.Chr5p1658484", "Lcu.1GRN.Chr2p44545877") )
# Save
ggsave("figures/gg_Marker_Scatter_03.png", 
       mp, width = 6, height = 4 )
```

![](figures/gg_Marker_Scatter_03.png)
